title: Haunted Hallway Shadows
description: A long, narrow hallway with lime green walls and terracotta tile flooring. An open white door on the left reveals a shadowy hand pressed against its surface, while the far end opens into a bright, warm light with faint plant silhouettes visible.
prompt: A long narrow hallway with lime green walls that have subtle purple and pink gradients, white baseboards, and terracotta colored square tile floor. An open white door on the left side shows a dark shadowy hand pressed against it from inside the room. At the far end of the hallway is an open doorway emitting bright warm light with faint plant silhouettes visible. Soft colored light patterns on the walls and ceiling, sparkling particles floating in the air, eerie and surreal atmosphere.
